comment: Omberg's Arborist looks (copied from Vreta's file and tuned since). Who draws a zone palette item (grass-palette.json) is its model's renderer (models.json); plantSettings are the course-wide defaults for the lower vegetation Arborist draws, and a model's own look wins over them. Which trees Arborist draws is not set here: the trees are models of models.json (their own looks there) and the routing (vegetation-rules.json `routing`) decides before planting who draws each one. treeSettings / plantSettings cap how bright the leaf and bark tints may be (see arborist.py apply_look): Arborist's defaults (0.8-1.0) are far too bright under this course's light; the values follow WaterfrontGC_GSP's (birch 0.36, oak and poplar about 0.5, pine 0.6-0.7, saturation left at 1). lodFactor: the detailed model is kept this many times further out; the simpler distance models of the broadleaves are a few large leaf cards, each lit on its own, which mottles the crowns at 50-150 m (seen in Arborist 2026-10-12, where the quality setting's LOD bias is 0.7).
vegeSettings_comment: Written into the file's VSProSettings.vegeSettings, which GSPro's Arborist system runs with (only keys the file has). PlantDistance (Marcus 2026-10-14): 350 -> 250 m saved 0.6 ms a frame at tee 1 (live in GSPro, main-thread CPU: the system culls fewer cells) with no visible difference from tee 1, the hole 4 tee and hole 6; trees stay full models to PlantDistance + AdditionalTreeMeshDistance (563 m). Omberg 2026-10-16 (Marcus): the course is open and one sees further, so PlantDistance 300: the bushes draw to all of it (renderDistance 1), the small ground plants to 0.5 of it (150 m), and everything thins out from 40 % of its distance (falloffStart) instead of ending in a line.

treeSettings.note: 2026-10-12: visually tuned in Arborist at close and medium range. Remove the leaf texture's yellow/olive colour variation and supply a uniform green tint; keep its shading and texture detail. The course's Arborist postprocessing lift.w was also raised from -0.20678772 to -0.03 to retain dark-leaf detail; scene lighting is unchanged. Billboard calibration is unchanged.

2026-10-18 (Marcus, in Arborist Ultra beside the beeches and an oak): darker leaves and a darker, warmer trunk than the calibrated #9fa5a9 / barkCap 0.7, whose trunk looked unnatural. Of four steps he found #868c90/#6e6862 and #73797c/#58534e both good; this one measured as the beech (crown luma 57/42 sunlit/back-lit against beech_05's 54/46), the other darker than every neighbour (49/34).
2026-10-18: calibrated at 1.362 for the old leaf tint #9fa5a9; scaled by the new tint's 0.85 until the billboard is measured again (calibrate.py billboards).

2026-10-13: Forst's oaks as Arborist's own items (forstRing). Tint measured in GSPro against the course's CTI Forst oaks from 22 m, June sun: crown mean 80/84/56 against 79/83/57. lodFactor 1 as the course's VSP items of the same meshes. The billboard (beyond the Arborist tree distance) is not calibrated.

treeSettings.comment: Omberg hole 9's pond plants (2026-10-19). The Lake Plants shader (Arb_Standard) has one colour (MainColor), saturation, brightness (an offset: -0.05 turns plants grey), smoothness (no visible effect) and OcclusionStrength. Reeds, flags and flowers: brightness -0.03, saturation 1.5.

The pads (not the flowers) read pale cream in sun and from a low angle: the textures hold tan old pads and the sky reflects off flat pads. A green MainColor, saturation 3 and OcclusionStrength 3 give green pads top-down and from low (2026-10-19).

plantSettings.comment: Hazel's leaf texture is dark: under the common tint it drew near black in GSPro from every side (2026-10-13). Tried live with veg.material.

routing_comment: 2026-10-20: who draws each tree is the routing, decided before planting (vegetation-rules.json `routing`: the far rule and outerKeep moved there); the poplars, pines and firs are Arborist models of models.json with their looks; the Forst oaks and birches stay the course's VSP models, their billboard stand-ins are models.json billboardAs.
lower_comment: 2026-10-21: the 'species' map moved into the model library: each bush or ground plant Arborist draws is an arborist:<label> model of models.json (PF Birch F Sapling -> MeadowEnv_00_Poplar_plant_A, Cottonwood -> MeadowEnv_maple_bush_03, the ferns Forest_fern_01_1/3). Prefab_billberry_04 (the tall bilberry) and the ferns stay VSP models: NatureManufacture's grass-shader plants light their back faces as fronts, so from the sun's side a big bilberry bush or fern frond is white in Arborist (the cure, _BackFaceMirrorNormal, is not among the values Arborist stores).
